Hannah: Pen test reminder for next week. Need a minimal ops checklist: RBAC, KMS for evidence, audit export path, and retest slots. Can owners volunteer?
Tom: I can own RBAC + ephemeral role automation. Plan: role `pt-assessor-1901234567` with max session 4h and tag `pt-window=1901234567`.
Ravi: I'll handle KMS & grants. We'll create `alias/pt-evidence-1901234567` and grant only to the assessor role + ingestion service. Revoke grant automatically when window ends.
Yara: Logs: export CloudTrail + app access logs to `s3://rw-pt-evidence/1901234567/` under `audit/` and `raw/`. Presigned PUTs 4h expiry, require SHA256 checksum file next to upload.
Tom: quick IAM sample to hand to assessors: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1901234567"}]}
```
Ravi: KMS create grant example (ops): ```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-1901234567 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1901234567 --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name pt-grant-1901234567
```
Yara: add lifecycle rules: raw 30d, parsed alerts 180d. Mirror parsed alerts to SIEM. Also record assume-role events + grant IDs into the audit path.
Hannah: retest windows: Thu 11:00-12:00 and Fri 15:00-16:00. Please add to ticket and calendar.
deploy-bot: Jira RW-PT-2026-1901234567 created: "pen-test: RBAC/KMS/evidence runbook". Assigned to Tom, Ravi, Yara.
Tom: I'll open a PR with terraform module + presign integration and ping this thread.
Ravi: I'll post grant IDs and revoke job details after creation.
Yara: I'll set bucket lifecycle and verification lambda for checksum recording.
Hannah: Action items summary: Tom (role + presign), Ravi (KMS grant + revoke), Yara (logs + lifecycle + verifier). Dry-run Tue 07:00, live Tue 09:00. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
